Title: Solution Purpose: Cyréna Documentation Site (Docs Only)
Content:
This solution is the documentation site for the Cyréna platform. It is a docs-only Angular application — all marketing, landing, download, and extensions content has been moved to static HTML (docs.html) maintained separately.

Core Responsibilities:
- Technical documentation (getting started, guides, API reference)
- Developer documentation (Cyrena.Core, Persistence, Extensa, Components, Coding)
- Platform feature documentation (.NET, Arduino, PlatformIO, Angular)
- FAQ and support information
- Privacy policy page (required because we use web analytics tracking)

What Cyréna Actually Is:
- Offline-first desktop application (runs natively on your machine)
- NOT a web service, NOT a SaaS, NOT a server with endpoints
- Model-agnostic platform — NOT an AI model itself
- Users can connect Ollama (local/offline) or OpenAI (cloud) and switch between them in any chat at any time
- The platform orchestrates LLMs; the user brings the model
- No data leaves the machine when using local models
- Open source and extensible
- EXTENSIBLE — users build extensions (not plugins) to expand Cyréna beyond coding into custom integrations, workflows, and business-specific tooling

Documentation Pages:
- /#/docs — Docs landing with cards for all topics
- /#/docs/getting-started — Installation, configure connections, start chatting
- /#/docs/ui-overview — Tour of the Cyréna interface
- /#/docs/dotnet — .NET development guide
- /#/docs/angular — Angular project scaffolding and code generation
- /#/docs/arduino — Arduino IDE sketch support
- /#/docs/platformio — PlatformIO project support
- /#/docs/api-references — Shippable AI memory (.aiapi files)
- /#/developer — Developer docs landing
- /#/developer/core — Cyrena.Core contracts and models
- /#/developer/persistence — Persistence abstraction layer
- /#/developer/extensa — Extension system contracts
- /#/developer/components — Blazor UI contracts
- /#/developer/coding — Project-aware AI coding capabilities
- /#/developer/extensions — Extension development guide
- /#/privacy — Privacy policy explaining analytics practices

Privacy & Analytics:
- We use Cloudflare Web Analytics (privacy-first, no cookies, no persistent identifiers)
- Cloudflare does not set cookies, does not track across sessions/sites, anonymizes IP addresses
- We cannot identify individual visitors or extract personal data from analytics — data is fully aggregated and anonymous
- We do NOT collect personal identifiers, precise location, or cross-site tracking data
- Raw IP addresses are not stored — only anonymized geographic summaries
- Data retention: maximum 26 months
- Visitors can opt out by blocking static.cloudflareinsights.com

Non-goals:
- Not a marketing/landing page site (moved to static docs.html)
- Not a download page (moved to static docs.html)
- Not an extensions marketplace (moved to static docs.html)
- Not a SaaS application with user accounts
- Not a real-time data dashboard
- Not a multi-tenant application
- Not an AI model provider
- Not a plugin system (we use "extensions", never "plugins")

Styling: Bootstrap CSS with custom dark theme accents
Routing: Hash-based location strategy (/#/routes)
Target: Angular v18+ with standalone components and signals
